evidence_strength.note: Evidence Strength（评审 2026-08-22 命名收紧）：synthetic < test_runtime < virtual_device_runtime（模拟器）< physical_device_runtime（真机）< visual < human_confirmed。Emulator PASS ≠ release gate PASS——achieved=virtual_device_runtime 不满足 minimum_required=physical_device_runtime（真机）。
